title.narrative: Activity under preparation Support Measures Uganda

description.narrative: The Support Measures action intends to contribute to all priority areas of the MIP and its Team Europe Initiatives. The action includes two components:- Cooperation Facility (component 1)This action aims to strengthen the EU-Uganda partnership by supporting (i) the review and phasing-out of programmes funded under the 11th EDF and 2021-2027 MIP (ii) the design of new programmes funded under the 2028 onwards period. The action will support donor coordination and analysis; short and medium term technical assistance, studies, meetings, seminars, awareness raising events, workshops, as well as project preparation, monitoring, evaluation. The Cooperation Facility may also contribute to the adequate integration of important cross-cutting issues such as youth, gender, refugee response, digitalisation, or conflict prevention.- Strategic communication (component 2)In line with the new approach to Strategic Communication and Public Diplomacy under NDICI-Global Europe, activities will seek to increase awareness and understanding of the EU in Uganda through large-scale communication campaigns. These strategic communication activities will demonstrate the EU¿s positive offer to Uganda, and position the EU and Team Europe as trusted and reliable partners in areas of strategic interest. They will promote the EU¿s offer on digital infrastructure, climate and energy, transport, health, and education through the Global Gateway.
